title: TC Promotions Limited and Others v Lusaka City Council [2025] ZMCC 18 (30 September 2025)
case_name: TC Promotions Limited and Others v Lusaka City Council
issue_tags: Article 199(2) and (3) — local government revenue authority
Urban and Regional Planning Act No. 3 of 2015
private commercial function of local authority
outcome_detail: Petition dismissed (paragraph [89]: "The petition lacks merit and is hereby dismissed"). Court held the Lusaka City Council resolution of 27 September 2023 on billboard/planning permission fees was not a statutory instrument requiring gazetting under Article 67(2); Articles 199(2) and (3) were not contravened because the resolution was made in the exercise of the Council's private commercial function and did not create legislative requirements for the public. Parties bear their own costs (paragraph [90]).
